displayPattern: PCBHR104 unitary diagnostic display in Goodman service manual RS6200007 (ASXC, DSXC, GSXC condensing units and ASZC, DSZC, GSZC heat pumps). Digit 3 is blank, digit 2 is A, digit 1 is 2. The code is A2
meaning: Outdoor air temperature sensor fault. The integrated control module shows A2. The air conditioner or heat pump may show only this code, with no separate symptom line on this row.
diySteps: Write down A2 before you turn power off. Digit 3 on this chart is blank
Technician: check the sensor connection and replace an open or shorted sensor. Turn power off before the repair. The chart says to use the correct replacement part
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. This is a sensor circuit, not a filter code.
sourceTitle: Goodman service manual RS6200007 r27, PCBHR104 unitary diagnostic codes
